classification.difficultyReason: Identify the retained percentage and apply the same multiplier six times, then express the remaining fraction as a percentage.

content.prompt: I take a sealed glass container and remove $60\%$ of the air. Then I remove $60\%$ of the remaining air. I do this six times altogether. What percentage of the original air is left in the container?

answer.worked:
Each removal leaves $100\%-60\%=40\%$ of the air present immediately beforehand.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Fraction remaining after six removals}&=(0.4)^6\\\text{Fraction remaining after six removals}&=0.004096\\\text{Percentage of original air remaining}&=0.004096\times100\%\\\text{Percentage of original air remaining}&=0.4096\%\end{align*}$$
